title: How to maintain a McQuay AC?
desc:
To maintain your McQuay AC:
- Keep coils clean
- Trim shrubbery around the unit
- Direct dryer vents away from the AC
- Seal open ducts and check insulation
- Replace air filters regularly
- Adjust the thermostat properly
- Schedule annual professional maintenance with FAJ HVAC experts

title: Why does my McQuay air conditioner keep shutting off?
desc: Dirty coils and condenser units can cause overheating, making the AC shut off and restart frequently. Ensure the area around the unit is clean and free from debris such as leaves or dirt.

title: How do you reset a McQuay AC thermostat?
desc: Simultaneously press the up and down arrows on the thermostat. This will reset the unit to its factory settings, so you’ll need to re-enter any custom programming.

title: How often does my McQuay AC need maintenance?
desc: It is recommended to service your McQuay AC twice a year, ideally before summer and winter seasons, to prevent breakdowns and ensure peak efficiency.

title: How do I know if my AC needs maintenance?
desc:
Signs your AC needs maintenance include:
- Unusual noises
- Reduced cooling
- High DEWA bills
- Water leaks
- Excess humidity
- Weak airflow

title: What is the internal control fault detected by McQuay (Error 93)?
desc: Error Code 93 indicates a malfunction in the internal control system, typically due to abnormal outdoor ambient temperature readings or a faulty control board.

title: What does McQuay AC error code E3 or F3 mean?
desc: E3 or F3 suggests a thermostat or PCB (Printed Circuit Board) fault. The error affects temperature regulation and may require component replacement.

title: What is McQuay AC error code E1?
desc: E1 indicates a communication issue between the indoor and outdoor units, potentially caused by faulty wiring or control board failure.

title: What does McQuay AC error code E4 mean?
desc: E4 refers to a problem with the outdoor temperature sensor or its wiring. Inspect for damage, corrosion, or loose connections. If unresolved, professional service may be needed.

title: What does McQuay AC error code E6 mean?
desc: E6 signals a communication failure between the indoor and outdoor components. Causes may include wiring issues, malfunctioning control boards, or power supply disruptions.
